name: Trumbull County, OH
findings: Trumbull County has 613 nonprofit organizations. 227 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 185 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Trumbull County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Trumbull County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 128 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 14 union organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 52 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
